cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The wedding venue has made a small change. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

mechanism: A manages a wedding disruption by disclosing venue damage in protective layers, revising the next step when B resists reassuring control.
confusable: Generic euphemism lacks successive true disclosures that alter what the earlier reassurance meant and protect someone in the interaction.
comparison: Gnome alternative concerns sentimental property and a smaller repair, rather than a major event date.
seedUse: Venue seed provides date-versus-building reveal; S02 should adjust a real planning proposal when B needs the direct truth.
